thread:
Alex: Quick ask — can we approve a bespoke trial credit for NimbusApps? They want a 3-month trial with heavy usage (est. 50k/mo) and are requesting a $25,000 prepaid credit + net30 invoicing so they can start onboarding. Deal is SMB strategic with expansion potential. Need sign-off by EOD today.
Lina: What's the expected ARR/ACV if they convert? Need business justification and erosion controls. Also please attach the quote + SOW. Here's the deal desk link for formality: https://redwood.internal/dealdesk
Alex: Conservative estimate if converted ~ $120k ARR. Uploaded SOW/quote to Drive: https://drive.redwood/nimbus/sow_v2 (just uploaded). Customer is migrating from a competitor; fast ramp but some churn risk.
Omar: From RevOps — recommend limiting the trial credit to $20k not $25k, require explicit usage caps and auto-fallback to PAYG after trial. Also suggest we gate the credit on achievement metrics (e.g., 30% query volume week-over-week) so we can measure engagement.
Kayla: Legal: need DPA/security review for net30 and data access. Also we can't accept any custom indemnities; if sales needs contract changes, legal needs to review the redlines.
Lina: Finance policy note: marketing/strategic trial credits allowed up to 20% of expected first-year ACV without exec approval. 20% of $120k = $24k, so $25k is borderline. I can approve up to $24k one-time credit, provided it's coded to 'Customer Incentive' and there's a signed SOW/PO. No recurring discounts beyond trial without exec sign-off.
Alex: Got it — can we do $24k then? I can update the quote immediately. Need your explicit sign-off to move forward.
Derek-bot: Deal desk submission received from @Alex — https://redwood.internal/dealdesk/submissions/98765. Status: pending finance approval.
Lina: I approve a one-time $24k trial credit + net30 for NimbusApps, conditional on: signed SOW, completed DPA/security checklist, and RevOps usage cap config. Bookkeeping: tag as 'customer_incentive_nimbus_2065'. Please confirm here when documents are attached. :white_check_mark:
Omar: +1 — will configure caps and auto-fallback.
Kayla: +1 pending DPA completion. Will fast-track review once SOW is attached.
Alex: Thanks — updating quote to $24k and will attach SOW/PO when signed. Will ping once done.
Lina: Finance will prepare the credit memo after we get signed SOW and PO. Reminder: no additional credits without exec approval. Closing notes logged in deal desk submission.
notes: Approval thread for a bespoke SMB trial credit; conditional approvals from Finance, RevOps, and Legal.
